- GDPR: We support data residency controls, DSR processes, and have DPA templates.
- HIPAA: We offer BA agreements and optional private deployment models for PHI workloads.

- Confirm specific controls in-scope for SOC (data handling, encryption, key management).
- Provide evidence for encryption at-rest and in-transit, KMS/HSM integration, and audit logs.
- Complete your vendor security questionnaire and return to us.

3) Proposed next steps / owners:
- I will share the SOC 2 artefact and a one-pager on our compliance roadmap (Marissa).
- Our security lead Dev Patel will follow up with answers to specific control questions and sample evidence (Dev).
- Please send back the vendor questionnaire and any additional procurement templates (Alicia/Tom).

Hi Tom / Alicia — Dev here (Security Lead) — thanks for the questions. High level answers below; happy to dive deeper on any control.

- SOC 2 Type II: Yes, our SOC 2 Type II report covers Redwood's hosted API environment for the period Jul 2024 - Jun 2025. The attached summary highlights in-scope systems and control categories (CC1-CC7 mapped). Full report can be shared under NDA.

- GDPR / DPA: We provide a standard DPA; we also support data residency via regional hosting and contractual commitments on sub-processors. I've attached the compliance roadmap which includes planned enhancements to our data subject request tooling.

- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. We offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and provide Private deployment options for customers that prefer network isolation. Hosted customers can store/process PHI under a signed BAA; we document required configuration and operational practices in the onboarding playbook.

Evidence & controls we can provide immediately (samples):
- Encryption: At-rest AES-256 (KMS) and TLS1.3 in transit — sample key rotation logs available.
- Access controls: SSO with SCIM, role-based access, audit log extracts.
- Logging & monitoring: Retention and SIEM integration details.

Attachments provided: SOC2_Type_II_Redwood_2025.pdf (summary), Compliance_Roadmap-2026Q2.pdf

If you'd like us to start the vendor security questionnaire, please attach it and we'll assign a primary owner (sec-requests@redwood.com) and target a 5-7 business day turnaround for standard questionnaires. For lengthy or bespoke questionnaires we'd propose a 2-week SLA.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
